measurement.inputs: Current src/assets/manifest.ts, assets/characters/<fighter>/frames.json, PNG IHDR dimensions and file sizes.
measurement.drawingSlots: A distinct URL plus crop rectangle; repeated references share a slot. Separate rectangles or URLs count separately even if their pixels are identical. This is not a count of 60 Hz simulation frames.
measurement.rgba8Bytes: width * height * 4 per physical PNG. Runtime-key estimate assumes one full sheet allocation per cache key; unique-URL estimate deduplicates keys sharing a URL.
measurement.memoryLimits: Estimates exclude mipmaps, driver overhead, transient copies and CPU/browser decoded-image retention. They are neither measured CPU/GPU/process usage nor an additive CPU+GPU total. PNG disk bytes are compressed file sizes.
measurement.actionRows: Per-action sheet costs are descriptive, not additive when clips share a URL. Totals deduplicate URLs or count runtime keys explicitly. Top memory actions reference the action rows below.
measurement.scope: No image decoding, content hashing, browser execution, budget enforcement or asset mutation. Only --out writes a report.
